image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a brown dog, identified as a Rhodesian Ridgeback, standing in snow. The image focuses on the head and shoulders, showing a green collar. The background is a blurred white snowy field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is fairly long and flat with moderate stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The profile view clearly shows a long muzzle and a relatively flat skull with a gentle transition (stop) to the snout, matching the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are round, bright, and intelligent, color matching coat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible eye is round with a warm amber/brown hue that complements the wheaten coat. Reflections suggest brightness/intelligence.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are set high, medium-sized, and carried close to head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible ear is folded down but sits high on the skull and lies relatively close to the cheek, consistent with the breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ridge of reversed hair growing forward along spine from shoulders to hips forming two symmetrical crowns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The angle of the photo (high angle, focused on head/neck) and the presence of the collar obscure the spine area where the ridge would be located. It is impossible to verify the presence of the whorls or the ridge line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is short, dense, sleek, and glossy ranging from light wheaten to red wheaten.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur appears very short and smooth with a slight sheen, typical of the breed. The color is a consistent reddish-wheaten brown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is muscular and athletic with deep chest of large hound proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The neck is thick and muscular, transitioning into a broad shoulder area, suggesting the powerful build of a large hound.
The visible front leg in the background appears straight and has substantial girth, indicating muscle mass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely outside the frame of the image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog is standing still or moving slowly; 'gait' implies dynamic motion which cannot be fully assessed in a static close-up portrait.

artifact_observations.location: Snow background and lower jaw edge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The snow texture is overly uniform and plastic-like, lacking granular detail. There is slight softness/bleeding at the boundary between the dark muzzle and the white snow, typical of AI generation smoothing edges.

The rear/front leg visible in the background lacks a defined paw or clear termination point; it fades into the snow blur without anatomical precision, suggesting a minor structural ambiguity common in AI images.
